# Samuel Burke

> Independent software developer and founder of Burke Systems, a small software studio in Raleigh-Durham, NC. Builds products end to end, from design to deployment.

## Work

- [ShiftView](https://shiftview.app): Scheduling and a time clock for retail and fulfillment teams. Built solo with Next.js 16, React 19, Supabase and TypeScript. Deterministic auto-scheduler, real-time coverage, two-layer security (API route handlers plus row-level security), 1,600+ automated tests. Source: https://github.com/samuel-burke/shiftview. Case study (architecture, auth and security, CI/CD): https://samuelburke.dev/work/shiftview/
- [samuelburke.dev](https://github.com/samuel-burke/samuel-burke-dev): This site. Built with coding agents against a written design spec (DESIGN.md), statically exported to Cloudflare Pages.

## Background

- Founder, Burke Systems (2026–now)
- B.S. Computer Science, NC State University (Fall 2024)
- QA engineering intern, ZenGRC (Summer 2022): wrote end-to-end tests for the QA team
